purpose: `<StyleStudio />` is a React screen for choosing the app's colours, fonts, buttons, windows and logo before building, and `saveStyle` writes the result to the app's resource vault.
namedChanges: 0.3.1. the website reader says "This site does not allow its style to be read. Try another site." for a 502 site_status of 401, 403 or 429 and for site_refused, and "The site could not be reached." for site_unreachable (friction 58). Additive.

0.3.0. the page background is its own choice, apart from the palette: a Background selector left of the Light/Dark button (light: white, off-whites and very light tints; dark: five dark options); a palette or seed change keeps accent and hues only and leaves paper alone; `paletteToSheetColors(palette, mode, paper?)` no longer writes a palette colour into paper or surface (new optional third argument; default white / dark grey); a new tab "Many colours" after "One colour" where every colour is typed by hand (stored exactly as typed, source kind `manual`, saved as handPicked); while the source is `manual` a background pick sets paper and surface only and repairs nothing;

0.2.3. new, additive: the subpath `/vite` (`dev/vite.mjs`, types `dev/vite.d.mts`): `styleStudioSave({ tokensPath, logoPath?, route?, maxLogoBytes?, maxBodyBytes? })`, a Vite plugin that serves `POST /__studio/save` and writes the sheet and the logo (the dev-server half of `makeDevServerSave`, from the PictureRecords run's `vite.config.ts`); dev server only, paths inside the project root, `application/json` only, PNG or SVG by its bytes, size limits. README: the Vite and `@vitejs/plugin-react` versions, verified on 2026-11-15;

0.2.2. `ThemeToggle` and `ModeButton` moved to `style-runtime` (subpath `/react`, since style-runtime 0.2.1) and `src/ThemeToggle.tsx` re-exports them; `ActionRow` keeps its spec-object API but is now an adapter over style-runtime's row (one component, one CSS; its private inline CSS is gone) and the barrel also exports the slot-based row as `ActionRowSlots`; the tests that pinned the inline `<style>` text and an empty `<head>` now test behaviour (DOM order, classes, the CSS present once); the host-agnostic check allows the `/react` subpath;

0.2.1. new, additive: `ExtractClientOptions.credential` (anything with `authHeaders(method, url)`; it signs exactly `POST <baseUrl>/base/style/extract`, no import of signin), `splitLogo` (src/studio/splitLogo.ts) and `makeDevServerSave` (src/studio/devServerSave.ts); the README example wires From website by default

the colour and sheet engine (`schema`, `color`, `css`, `palette`) is the separate unit `style-runtime`; every import of it is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-style-runtime`, and `ThemeToggle` imports its theme functions from there;

**the host constant becomes an option** (RuleGhsSettingUnit): the exported `PUBLIC_GRANTEE` (a vault-host address) is removed; `publicGrantee: string` is a required field of `SaveStyleOptions` and of the `vault` prop of `StyleStudio`, and the grant call sends it as the principal;

the source's tests moved from `test/` to `src/`; the test of the dev page's demo note is not taken (the dev page is not in this unit); tests that call `saveStyle` or pass `vault` pass a `publicGrantee` of an example address;

0.2.0: the vault reader (`loadStyleFromVault`, `makeVaultFetchRemote`, `recordsToSheet`, `linkId`), `defaultSheet` and the list of bundled font names moved to `style-runtime`; this unit re-exports them, and `build-fonts.mjs` also writes the names list into `style-runtime`;
the barrel `src/index.ts` exports only this unit's own API; the engine and the theme functions come from `style-runtime`;
the check `scripts/check-host-agnostic.mjs` allows relative imports that stay inside `src/`, `dompurify`, the runtime package, React, and `@fontsource/<name>/latin-400.css` or `latin-600.css`.

library.title: App Style Studio (choose the app's style before building)
library.note: Choose the app's colours (palettes incl. after Sanzo Wada, one seed colour, or read from your website), fonts, buttons, windows and logo before building, and save them to the app's resource vault or the dev server. From website works with the app's session through makeExtractFromUrl({ baseUrl, credential }); makeDevServerSave and splitLogo save to a dev server, and the Vite plugin styleStudioSave (studio save) is the server half that writes the files. A developer tool, taken once. Also found as: style guide; app style guide.
